jutsu_domain.note: A sealed black dome with a staring eye: a Domain Expansion, or Tsukuyomi. Open to any world.

jutsu_push.note: A sphere of force that blasts everything away (Shinra Tensei; also a Smash air-pressure blast). Open to any world.

ki_lightning_hand.note: The Chidori / Raikiri: lightning chirping in one hand.

ki_spiral.note: The Rasengan: a spinning sphere driven from the palm.

saga_seriouspunch.note: One punch, a colossal cone of air pressure: Saitama's Serious Punch, All Might's Detroit Smash, Might Guy's Evening Elephant. Shonen-wide, open to any world.

haki_conqueror.note: Conqueror's Haki itself: the manga flash, black-red lightning and a ring of will that cracks the floor.

haki_quakebubble.note: Whitebeard's quake: a bubble of cracked air round the fist, shattered like glass.

haki_toonrubber.note: Gear 5's toon ascension: bouncing cel clouds, a rubber shell and a sunburst.

haki_frostaura.note: Orbiting ice shards and a frosted floor: any ice user awakened.

haki_voltaura_a.note: A blue plasma skin with crawling ridges: reads as Killua's Godspeed.

haki_voltaura_b.note: A cage of yellow lightning bars re-striking on twos.

haki_voltaura_c.note: A violet lightning crown studded with spinning drum-rings: Enel's thunder drums.

haki_steamaura.note: Toon steam boiling off a red-hot body: the Eight Gates, a kaiju heating up.

haki_blackflameaura.note: Ink-black flame with violet and crimson rims that stays black in daylight.

titan_spiritarmor.note: A translucent purple armoured giant built rib by rib: Sasuke's Susanoo.

titan_hundredpalm.note: Netero's Hyakushiki Kannon: the golden many-armed statue's palm.

titan_firefist.note: A giant fist of banded toon fire punched down the line: Ace's Hiken.

titan_magmafist.note: A giant magma-veined rock fist from the sky: Akainu's Meteor Volcano.

titan_iceblock.note: A giant faceted ice block dropped on a zone, ringed with frost spikes.

titan_thundercloud.note: A boiling cel thundercloud firing forked strikes: Nami's Thunderbolt Tempo, Enel's Raigo.

titan_lightninghound.note: A hound of lightning galloping down the line: Kakashi's lightning beast.

titan_reiatsupillar.note: Reiatsu released to the sky as a flame-shaped pillar: a Bankai coming out.

edge_petalswarm.note: Thousands of pink petal-blades: Byakuya's Senbonzakura scattering.

edge_energyclaw.note: Five energy talons raked down from the sky: Grimmjow's Desgarron.

edge_blackcrescent.note: A pure-black crescent with a white rim, the world drained to black: Ichigo's Getsuga in its final form.

edge_onislash.note: A flame-fringed demon mask rising behind the swing: Zoro's Asura.

edge_scythe.note: A pale spectral scythe reaping almost a full circle.

edge_chainsaw.note: Denji's chainsaw bar growing from the forearm and grinding in.

edge_firearrow.note: A drawn bow glyph and a blazing arrow that bursts in a cel fire blast.

edge_fingerbeam.note: A needle-thin fingertip ray: Frieza's Death Beam, Kizaru's finger laser.

edge_heartbeam.note: Boa Hancock's Mero Mero fruit: a ray of spiralling hearts that turns the target to stone.

edge_palmblast.note: Palm explosions walking down the line hand after hand: Bakugo's blasts.

seal_blackcoffin.note: Aizen's Hado #90 Kurohitsugi: a black coffin of crawling script, spears driven through.

seal_stringcage.note: Doflamingo's Birdcage: glowing strings fall into a dome that contracts.

seal_hexwall.note: A hexagon-cell wall that stops shots: the A.T. Field.

seal_trigrams.note: Hinata's (and Neji's) Eight Trigrams sixty-four palms: the diagram, then doubling volleys.

seal_shrinedomain.note: Sukuna's Malevolent Shrine: the floor drowns crimson, the horned shrine heaves up and slashes.

seal_timestop.note: ZA WARUDO / The World: a colour-inverted sphere and a grey, stopped world.

seal_elasticstrand.note: Hisoka's Bungee Gum: a pink strand that sticks, goes taut and snaps back.

seal_sproutarms.note: Nico Robin's Hana Hana: flowers open and arms sprout to clutch.

seal_tentacles.note: Kaneki's rinkaku kagune: segmented crimson tentacles from the back.

seal_ghostrush.note: A spectral double rises behind and rains ghost fists: a Stand-style rush. Draws copies of the caster only.

seal_pull.note: Pain's Bansho Ten'in: a gravity well in the palm hauls the target in.

seal_teleportmark.note: Minato's Flying Raijin: a seal-tagged kunai, then a blink to it. The engine moves the fighter.

seal_grapple.note: ODM gear: wires bite, gas jets fire, a high arc and a spinning cut. The engine moves the fighter.

seal_cursemark.note: A seal at the neck and black flame marks crawling over the skin: Sasuke's Cursed Seal (a Part 1 look).

seal_snowcompass.note: Rukia's Some no Mai, Tsukishiro: a snowflake circle on the floor, ice erupting along it.
